qualifications: Applicants describe a current leadership, policy or systems challenge within their area of responsibility that affects how people live and age
Priority to applicants in a position to translate learning into policy, organizational or systems-level action
description_short: WHO/Europe's in-person leadership course on population ageing runs 28-30 April 2027 in Bilbao, Bizkaia, for 40 participants. It is APHEA-accredited with a WHO certificate of participation. Applications opened 1 October 2026 and close 16 November 2026.
